syllabus: Is unit 1 (time and timing: 〜たびに, 〜ごとに, 〜おきに, 〜ぶりに, 〜て以来, 〜てはじめて, 〜ところに, 〜ところを, 〜最中に, 〜たとたん) a fair N3 set in a sensible order, given that 最中に and たとたん also sit in the N2 draft syllabus?
style: Only the N5, N4 and N3 kanji (about 700) are written in kanji; every other word is in kana (きんちょう, ぬれる). In teach and drill text only words with an N3 kanji carry a reading (最中 with さいちゅう above; 会社 bare). Exam-style items, the scene check, reading passages and listening choices have no readings. Does this match what an N3 learner should see?
Unlike the N5 and N4 courses, no text has spaces between phrases, as on the N3 paper (駅前から空港まで、バスが十五分（　　）出ています。). Is this right?
Right answers are spread evenly over positions 1 to 4, as on the real paper; options were reordered after writing. Is that fine, or does any option list read in an odd order?

New at N3: nothing is printed. The narrator sets the scene, one speaker talks for about 40 seconds, then come the question and four spoken options. Day 5 has the first one (radio news about a power cut). Is this version fair?

n3u01d1.p2: Connect rows give ごとに only after nouns, and ごとに is never a wrong option after a verb, since 会うごとに is grammatical. Fair way to teach it?
n3u01d1.c1: Answer たびに. ごとに and おきに fail only because of の (食事ごとに would be fine). Clearly wrong as written, after 食事の?
n3u01d1.d1: Answer たびに. Is ように clearly wrong (この写真を見るように、国の家族を思い出します)?
n3u01d1.d5: Rewritten after the check (この道は雨が降るたびに水がたまって). The ★ is on 降る, which may be easy to place. Please read once.
n3u01d1.e1: Answer たびに. Is 人の前で話す natural here, or should it be 人前で話す?
n3u01d2.p1: Watch says with time おきに skips one unit (一日おきに is every other day), but e1 一時間おきに and d5 三十分おきに mean every hour, every 30 minutes. Fair as stated?
n3u01d2.d3: Rewritten after the check (一週間おきに水をやれば十分です). 一週間おき can mean every week or every other week. Is おきに still the only answer?
n3u01d2.d4: Answer ぶりの (三年ぶりのふるさとは、ずいぶん変わっていました). Natural?
n3u01d2.d5: Rewritten after the check (医者に、三十分おきに目を休めるように言われました). Please read once.
n3u01d2.e1: Rewritten after the check (この時計は、一時間おきに音が鳴ります, meant as every hour). Please read once.
n3u01d2.e3: Star item: 二年ぶりの休みを取って、海へ行くつもりです. Natural?
n3u01d3.d2: Answer はじめて. 以来 is called wrong before a one-time 分かりました (also d5, e2). Clearly wrong? Are もらって and おいて too weak as options?
n3u01d3.d4: Answer から (着いてから、すぐに). 着いてばかりで fails only on form (着いたばかりで would fit). Fair as a wrong option?
n3u01d3.e2: Answer はじめて. おいて and ばかりで are weak options (社会に出ておいて, 出てばかりで). Fine for an exam-style item?
n3u01d3.e3: Star item ends 二人は二十年前に知り合って以来ずっと親しくしています. Natural?
n3u01d3.k1: Wrong reading げんじょう is a real word (現状) with other kanji. Fine as an option for 限定?
n3u01d4.c1: Answer ところを. ところに is called clearly wrong before 見られる here, before 写真をとられる (d2) and before 見つかる (e2). Confirm for all three?
n3u01d4.d4: Answer ところを. Two を close together (お忙しいところを、資料を見ていただいて). Natural?
n3u01d4.d6: Level: わざわざ (the ★ tile in お休みのところをわざわざ来ていただき). Fine at N3?
n3u01d4.r1: Rewritten after the check (お忙しいなか). The thank-you letter has no greeting or signature. Natural as written?
n3u01d5.d4: Answer 最中. Is たび clearly wrong (今は食事のたびなので)?
n3u01d5.e1: Answer 最中に. うえに and ところに fail on how they join 試合の (試合のうえに, 試合のところに). Clearly wrong to a native?
n3u01d5.e2: Answer とたん. うちに and までに fail only because they do not follow the た form (着いたうちに). Clearly wrong?
n3u01d5.e3: Rewritten after the check (カレーを作っている最中にしおがないことに気づきました), with no comma after 最中に. Please read once.
n3u01d5.k1: Level: ひかえる (外出はひかえてください). Fine at N3?
n3u01d5.r1: Option 電車が止まった理由 is wrong as a detail (the trains are mentioned). Clearly not the gist? Is そうです for hearsay natural in a news report?
n3u01d6.c1: Answer とたん. ところに is ruled out because dizziness does not come from outside. Clearly wrong? Is 頭がくらっとしました natural?
n3u01d6.d2: Answer ぶりに. 以来 is ruled out after a length of time, though 十五年以来の is seen in news. Clearly wrong in 十五年以来会いました?
n3u01d6.d4: Answer うちに, an N4 form that is not a unit point, on the まとめ day. Fair? Are たびに, とたん, 最中に clearly wrong after 温かい?
n3u01d6.d5: Star item 四年ごとに行われる大会が八年ぶりに日本で開かれます. Natural with 行われる and 開かれます together?
n3u01d6.d6: Rewritten after the check (去年ギターを始めて以来週に二回教室に通っています). Please read once.
n3u01d6.e1: Answer はじめて. Is 以来 clearly wrong before one moment of noticing (一人で旅行をして以来、…気づいた)?
n3u01d6.e2: Answer ところに. Are 最中に and とたん clearly wrong after 出ようとしていた?
n3u01d6.r1: Clinic notice: 熱がある方は…受付の者に声をかけてください. Is 受付の者 natural on a notice?
n3u01t.2: Answer あたえて (庭の木に水を与えて). Is 与える too bookish here, where やる is usual? Fine?
n3u01t.5: Answer 説明. Is 案内 clearly wrong (店の人に案内してもらいました)?
n3u01t.14: Answer ところを. Is ところに clearly wrong before 見られて? たびに and とたんに fail only on form after ている. パジャマのまま uses のまま (unit 2). Fine?
n3u01t.15: Rewritten after the check (さっき、窓を開けたとたん、大きなハチが入ってきました). Please read once.
n3u01t.17: Star item 洗濯物を外に出したところに雨が降ってきて. Natural, and is the ★ on 雨が too easy?
